data.title: Volvo tests humanoid robots at Belgium plant ahead of 2027 rollout
data.description: Volvo is training Hexagon's AEON humanoid robots at its Ghent factory, with a production rollout targeted for mid-2027.
data.author: Neetika Walter
data.keywords: AEON humanoid robot, automotive manufacturing, Factory Automation, Hexagon Robotics, Imitation Learning, Industrial humanoid robots, Manufacturing robotics, Volvo Ghent plant, Volvo humanoid robots, wheeled robots
